title: Second Shift
reference: F2 F2 F2 def F1 { forward forward activate } def F2 { F1 F1 turn_right }
hints: Main has three slots, but there are six switches round three sides. A routine can call another routine.
F1 walks two and switches. F2 does a whole side: F1, F1, turn. Main calls F2 three times.
F2 F2 F2 def F1 { forward forward activate } def F2 { F1 F1 turn_right }

story.intro: PATCH: "Second shift starts now. Routines can call routines, so a big job breaks into small ones."
